english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a critical assessment of a book, film, play, or other work.
Use this for an evaluative comment or for the activity of commenting, especially in public or more formal discussion.
Use this for a considered review, commentary, or detailed critical examination rather than a general expression of disapproval.
